OpenIddict.//SigningKeys: Production requires OpenIddict:Certificates:Signing and :Encryption arrays of password-protected PFX Path/Password entries, plus shared encrypted DataProtection configuration. Legacy PEM paths and ephemeral overrides are rejected. See docs/operations/key-rotation.md.

//Mcp: Set Mcp__ResourceIdentifier to the RFC 9728 `resource` identifier published at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. It must match what clients send in the RFC 8707 `resource` parameter. Left unset here so the request-origin fallback applies rather than a literal placeholder leaking into the metadata document (andy-auth#155).

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Set KnownProxies or KnownNetworks to the exact ingress peers assigned to this deployment. Empty lists retain loopback-only trust. Do not trust all private networks. The edge must overwrite forwarding headers and block direct container access; verify this in the deployment.

SecurityHeaders._comment: Issue #128. CSP enabled by default in Production; the policy is nonce-based (see Program.cs) so Razor views render without 'unsafe-inline' script/style elements.
